title: Austin: Hospital Lease, Airport Land, Legal
summary:
*   The entire meeting was a closed-door executive session, where sensitive city matters were discussed without public deliberation.
*   Key topics included negotiations for a lease agreement concerning Brackenridge Hospital and the acquisition of land for the New Airport Project.
*   The agenda also covered discussions on legal strategies for several lawsuits involving the city.
*   Advice was sought regarding the repayment of ineligible federal Community Development Block Grant expenditures and proposed amendments to Austin City Code Chapter 5-7.
